test_rename_axis_with_callable: test the rename method with a callable function to transform axis labels
test_rename_axis_with_dict: test the rename method with a dictionary mapping to transform axis labels
test_rename_axis_with_series: test the rename method with a Series object to transform axis labels
test_get_numeric_data: test the _get_numeric_data method to extract numeric columns from a DataFrame or Series
test_get_bool_data_empty_preserve_index: test the _get_bool_data method preserves index on empty boolean Series
test_nonzero_raises_ambiguous: test that bool() on pandas objects raises ValueError for ambiguous truth values
test_metadata_propagation: test that metadata is preserved on arithmetic and boolean operations
test_stat_unexpected_keyword: test that statistical methods reject unexpected keyword arguments
test_stat_non_defaults_args: test that statistical methods reject unsupported out parameter
test_truncate_out_of_bounds: test that truncate handles out-of-bounds before and after values gracefully
test_copy_and_deepcopy: test copy and deepcopy operations on DataFrame and Series objects
test_squeeze_series_noop: test that squeeze is a no-op on 1D Series objects
test_squeeze_frame_reindex: test that squeeze reduces a single-column DataFrame to a Series
test_squeeze_axis_argument: test squeeze with explicit axis argument on DataFrame objects
test_transpose_series: test that transpose is a no-op on Series objects
test_transpose_frame_roundtrip: test that double transpose restores the original DataFrame
test_take_series: test the take method on Series with integer indices including negatives
test_take_frame: test the take method on DataFrame with integer indices along axis 0
test_take_invalid_kwargs: test that take rejects unsupported keyword arguments like out and mode
test_flags_identity: test that flags property returns the same object on repeated access
